receipts.title: [AUDIT-R3-H6] Require Session terminal completion before releasing execution
receipts.body: Confirmed host-boundary counterexample: registered Session adapter ends its iterator without terminal; send returns agent_failed but releases, start records success and releases. Deterministic real SQLite/RPC/lock probe shows confirmStopped false was never consulted. Implement a separate narrow fix for start/send: incomplete terminal protocol is not settled proof; confirm stop or retain. No operator recovery API or per-turn stop-proof redesign. Red/green regressions and parent full tests + Sonnet 5.5 required. Evidence: firstmate-batch1-20261026/thread-b-round3-hypotheses.md. This is an audit defect, not a new roadmap feature.
